items.title: Russian Geran-4 jet-powered attack drones have nearly 60% interception rate – General Staff says

items.title: Finnish foreign minister: We do not seek to mediate in the war because we stand with Ukraine

items.teaser: The outcome of the humanitarian operation in Oleshky could help advance the peace process and build trust. Ukraine welcomes the initiative, which is aimed at saving lives.

items.teaser: The five Nordic countries — Finland, Norway, Denmark, Iceland, and Sweden — have provided Ukraine with about $50 billion in aid since February 2022.

items.title: On holiday celebrating Ukrainian language, Russia strikes publisher's warehouse in Kharkiv

items.title: Russian forces strike warehouse belonging to KSD publishing house
items.teaser: Russian invaders attacked the warehouse of the “Family Leisure Club” (KSD) publishing house.

items.title: Russian attack damages publisher's warehouse in Kharkiv
items.teaser: A warehouse belonging to KSD publishing house has been damaged due to a Russian attack on Kharkiv on 27 October. Staff are currently assessing the extent of the damage. No employees were injured.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Derhachi leaves five injured, causes damage
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the town of Derhachi in the Kharkiv district on the afternoon of October 27.

items.title: Denmark's Frederiksen criticizes Finland and Norway for calling Putin without coordinating with allies, despite consultation with Ukraine

items.title: Russen greifen Haus in Region Tschernihiw mit Drohne an, Frau und Kind verletzt

items.title: Hungary still blocks opening of Ukraine's EU accession negotiating clusters 4 and 5
items.teaser: European diplomats report that Hungary's stance remains unchanged regarding clusters 4 and 5, which cover areas like the green agenda and agriculture.

items.title: Ceasefire in Oleshky area to remain in effect until evening of November 1 – Arakhamia

items.title: Zelensky talks to Stubb and Støre after their call with Putin

items.title: Selenskyj zum nächtlichen Angriff: Russische Ziele fast überall – Energie, Logistik und städtische Infrastruktur
